prompt.en: How do Canada's many ethnic and religious groups live and work in the country?
prompt.fr: Comment les nombreux groupes ethniques et religieux du Canada vivent-ils et travaillent-ils au pays?

options.en: Side by side and in peace, as proud Canadians.
options.fr: Côte à côte et en paix, en tant que fiers Canadiens.

options.en: Apart from one another, each group in its own part of the country.
options.fr: Séparément, chaque groupe dans sa propre région du pays.

options.en: Only after they give up their own religion and customs.
options.fr: Seulement après avoir renoncé à leur religion et à leurs coutumes.

options.en: Under one official church chosen by the government.
options.fr: Sous une seule Église officielle choisie par le gouvernement.

explanation.en: Canada is home to people of many ethnic backgrounds and many faiths. They live and work here peacefully, proud to be Canadians. Canada also protects religious freedom and freedom of conscience.
explanation.fr: Le Canada compte des gens de nombreuses origines ethniques et de nombreuses confessions. Ils vivent et travaillent ici en paix, fiers d'être Canadiens. Le Canada protège aussi la liberté de religion et la liberté de conscience.

source.quote: Many ethnic and religious groups live and work in peace as proud Canadians.

verification.evidence: Many ethnic and religious groups live and work in peace as proud Canadians. … In Canada the state has traditionally partnered with faith communities to promote social welfare, harmony and mutual respect; to provide schools and health care; to resettle refugees; and to uphold religious freedom, religious expression and freedom of conscience. … Together, these diverse groups, sharing a common Canadian identity, make up today’s multicultural society.
